nodes.label: Generative AI, not AI
nodes.subtitle: What the book means by generative AI, how a language model works in plain words, where hallucinations come from, and where Dinis was corrected. 12 panels.

nodes.label: Generative AI, not AI
nodes.text: Generative AI, not AI: The technology this book is about is the one that generates.

nodes.label: AI has become a huge bucket, and to be honest the word gets abused a lot.
nodes.text: AI has become a huge bucket, and to be honest the word gets abused a lot.. AI → Machine learning → Deep learning → Generative AI
